paper_pages.52: Existing AgentSpeak files restore prior agent information. No second-mining-score target stated.
paper_pages.54: Model-entry adaptation allowed; container and host-GUI scenarios demonstrate feasibility.

source_findings: The 2022 native factory chooses list/ID.asl when present and miner3.asl otherwise.
The 2022 miner increments score after gold delivery and adds initial_print1.
Its active initial_print1 plan saves the agent and requests departure without removing initial_print1.
The 2023 executed source retains that lifecycle, with renamed plan labels and random test belief.
interpretation: The observed reload lifecycle has a pre-submission source antecedent. This does not prove execution equivalence across all 2022/2023 models. The frozen score-2 criterion remains failed; it is an additional control, not an explicitly published numeric target.
